parts.title: PART 1: READING INPUT  FORMAL DEBATE STRUCTURE
content: A formal Oxford-style debate has two teams: AFFIRMATIVE (FOR the motion) and NEGATIVE (AGAINST). Each team has a First Speaker, a Second Speaker, and a Rebuttal Speaker.
• Motion announced: 'This house believes that children under 12 should NOT be allowed smartphones.'
• Affirmative 1st Speaker (2 min): Defines terms + presents Team's main argument
• Negative 1st Speaker (2 min): Rejects affirmative argument + presents Team's main argument
• Affirmative 2nd Speaker (2 min): Presents second affirmative argument
• Negative 2nd Speaker (2 min): Presents second negative argument
• Affirmative Rebuttal (1 min): Responds to ALL negative arguments
• Floor Questions (5 min): Audience asks questions to either team
